title: Permanent settlement at Tell es-Sultan
summary: By the ninth and eighth millennia BCE, Tell es-Sultan near Jericho supported a substantial permanent settlement. Surviving walls, a ditch and a tower show coordinated work on shared structures.

claims.text: By the ninth and eighth millennia BCE, Tell es-Sultan near Jericho supported a substantial permanent settlement. Surviving walls, a ditch and a tower show coordinated work on shared structures.
Broad ninth–eighth-millennium evidence window; settlement began earlier.

The settlement makes collective infrastructure visible in early village life. Its archaeological sequence includes many phases; the walls should not automatically be assigned to narratives written much later.
